meta_description: Keyworks Locksmiths Liverpool provides 24/7 emergency lockout help, lock repairs, and key cutting. Fast response, fair prices. Call now for rapid assistance.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out? We're On Our Way
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or car in Liverpool? We arrive within 30 minutes, any time of day or night, with no call-out charge.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to lock repairs and key cutting, we handle every lock problem fast and fairly.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, flat, or office? We arrive fast with minimal fuss and no damage to your door. No call-out charge — you only pay for the work.

services.title: Car Lockout & Key Replacement
services.desc: Stranded with a locked car? We unlock most vehicles quickly and can code new keys on the spot. Handy for lost or broken car keys too.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Faulty mortice locks, snapped keys, or worn cylinders? We repair or replace broken locks with quality fittings that last.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: Need spare keys fast? We cut standard and security keys while you wait, using precision machinery for a perfect fit every time.

services.title: Landlord & Tenant Access
services.desc: Let us in when you've lost keys or need access to rental properties. We work quickly and keep detailed records for your protection.

services.title: UPVC & Modern Lock Upgrades
services.desc: uPVC doors giving trouble? We specialise in modern composite and uPVC locks, ensuring smooth operation and top security.

about_pullquote: I started Keyworks because no one should feel trapped outside their own home.
about_para_1: Keyworks Locksmiths was founded on a simple idea: help people when they're stressed, locked out, and need a fast, honest solution. We've built our reputation in Liverpool and Warrington by arriving on time, charging fair prices, and treating every job with care — whether it's a midnight lockout or a routine key cut. Our locksmiths carry the tools and expertise to handle everything from modern uPVC locks to traditional mortice locks.
about_para_2: What keeps customers coming back is our no-fuss approach. We don't charge call-out fees, we explain what we're doing, and we always fix problems properly the first time. Whether you're a homeowner, landlord, business, or motorist, you can trust us to be there when you need us — at any hour.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Friday night — panicked. Called Keyworks and they were here in 20 minutes. Friendly bloke, no fuss, no charge for the call-out. Very reasonable price. Brilliant service, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a broken lock on my front door and needed it fixed before a viewing. Keyworks came out same day, replaced the cylinder, and it works perfectly. Fair price and they tidied up after themselves. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Sarah J.

reviews.text: Car keys snapped in half while I was at work in town. Rang Keyworks, they got me a replacement key coded to my car within two hours. Sorted me out on a Saturday afternoon too. Top service.
reviews.author: Paul W.
